purpose: Benchmark entry: a real, public, historical DeFi exploit used to measure whether Argus's detection classes catch its on-chain footprint. Adapt the referenced DeFiHackLabs PoC + fork-validate to upgrade SPEC -> CONFIRMED.
mechanism: Guardian signature-verification bypass on Wormhole's Solana program. The verify_signatures instruction relied on the deprecated load_instruction_at (Solana solana_program::sysvar::instructions) to confirm that the Secp256k1 precompile had been invoked before signature verification, but load_instruction_at did NOT validate that the supplied account was the genuine Instructions sysvar (Sysvar1nstructions1111...). The attacker passed a spoofed/pre-crafted account in place of the real Instructions sysvar containing fabricated data indicating a successful prior Secp256k1 call. This caused the program to create a valid SignatureSet without any real guardian (2/3 quorum) signatures, letting the attacker forge a VAA (Verifiable Action Approval) that authorized minting 120,000 Wormhole-wrapped ETH (wETH) on Solana with no backing collateral. The attacker then bridged 93,750 of that wETH back to Ethereum (redeeming ~90,000 as withdrawals from the Ethereum Portal bridge contract, e.g. an 80,000 wETH withdrawal) and swapped the remaining ~26,250 wETH on Solana into ~432,662 SOL. Fix: Solana contracts patched to use load_instruction_at_checked, which validates the sysvar account.

provenance.victim_contract: Wormhole Solana core/token-bridge program (forged VAA mint); Ethereum Portal Token Bridge contract 0x3ee18B2214AFF97000D974cf647E7C347E8fa585 (wETH redeemed/withdrawn)
provenance.note: attacker_address is the SENDER of attack_tx_hash; attack_block is that tx's block (Etherscan-verifiable).

argus_mapping.argus_detection: Value/Token Transfer Outlier — Argus (EVM/Splunk-native) cannot observe the Solana-side signature forgery, but the Ethereum-side footprint is an anomalously large outflow (80,000 + 10,000 wETH ≈ $146M+ in single txs) from the bridge contract to the attacker, which a z-score on value drained would flag. Note: the actual root-cause logic (verify_signatures/sysvar spoofing) is on Solana and is a gap for an EVM-only detector.
